coverage: JEE Main 2015 Paper 1 final answer key for the 4 April offline Sets A-D and the 10 and 11 April online examinations.
verification: The PDF was preserved from the original official jeemain.nic.in host on 19 May 2015. Its official filename is 'Final Answer Key JEE 2015.pdf'. All three pages were downloaded, hashed, text-extracted and visually rendered. Pages 1-2 cover offline Sets A-D; page 3 covers the 10 and 11 April online examinations. The 90-question Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics structure matches the official Paper 1 question papers.
exclusions: Paper 2 B.Arch/B.Planning keys, candidate response sheets, question papers and third-party worked solutions are excluded.
hostingPolicy: Link-only. The PDF is linked through a preserved Internet Archive capture of the original official jeemain.nic.in host and is not mirrored by JEENEETARD.
